title: MalSkillBench
summary: A runtime-verified benchmark of malicious agent skills, together with the pipeline that builds it, for studying how coding agents can be subverted through the skill files they load. One catalogued skill is an SDV pipeline: `GaussianCopulaSynthesizer`, `SingleTableMetadata` and `PARSynthesizer` appear in a synthetic-training-pipeline skill filed under the malware category. The entry records SDV's presence in a corpus of adversarial agent skills, not an endorsement of the skill.

title: ML Research Analysis Corpus
summary: A structured corpus of roughly 121,000 machine-learning paper analyses covering arXiv from 2023 to 2025, each distilled to a fixed template. SDV enters as subject matter: the analysis of arXiv 2506.17847, a comparative study of SDV against synthcity, decomposes `GaussianCopulaSynthesizer`, `CTGANSynthesizer` and `TVAESynthesizer` into their pipelines. Nothing is run; the corpus describes SDV's architecture at second hand.
needs: arXiv 2506.17847 (SDV vs synthcity comparison) is not yet an index entry in its own right; queue for the paper lane

title: TrainDB model library
summary: The machine-learning model library behind TrainDB, training synopsis models used to answer approximate queries. SDV is the substrate for one of those models and for their scoring: `models/TVAE.py` imports both `sdv` and `rdt`, the base model runner pulls SDMetrics' `QualityReport`, and `ctgan` and `copulas` are pinned. This is the component repository the narrower TrainDB engine entry points at.

title: PyTorch JIT ParityBench
summary: A test suite measuring TorchScript parity with PyTorch across modules crawled automatically from popular GitHub projects. CTGAN's discriminator and TVAE's encoder appear as generated test cases, harvested from the vendored CTGAN copy inside tab-ddpm rather than from SDV directly. The relationship is second-hand: a crawler picked up code that another repository had already copied.

title: lolpop
summary: A software-engineering framework for bootstrapping machine-learning projects, assembled from swappable components. One component is an SDV adapter: `sdv_data_synthesizer.py` imports `SingleTableMetadata` and dispatches across `CTGANSynthesizer`, `CopulaGANSynthesizer` and `GaussianCopulaSynthesizer`, with `sdv` declared as an optional extra. SDV is the framework's synthetic-data backend rather than a core dependency.

title: OncoGAN
summary: A pipeline simulating high-quality synthetic cancer genomes, emitting VCFs, copy-number alterations and structural variants for use where real patient genomes cannot be shared. SDV generates the mutation-position distributions: the training notebooks import `CTGANSynthesizer` and `TVAESynthesizer` alongside `SingleTableMetadata` and the local CSV loader, with `sdv==1.4.0` pinned in both the training and simulating environments. A genomics application where the tabular layer is SDV's.

title: STDG evaluation metrics
summary: A study proposing standardised metrics and methods for evaluating synthetic tabular data, run across several public datasets. SDV is one of the generators under evaluation and supplies two of the three arms: notebooks import `from sdv import SDV`, `CTGANSynthesizer` and `GaussianMultivariate` from copulas, with output directories named per generator. SDV is the object of measurement rather than the measuring instrument here.

title: TableDiffusion
summary: Implementation of a differentially private diffusion model for tabular data, with the baselines it is compared against. CTGAN is both a pinned dependency and an architectural donor: `utils.py` imports the CTGAN synthesizer for comparison, and the model file carries TVAE's encoder structure. The paper's claim is measured against SDV's generators.

title: BEAS
summary: A blockchain-based framework for asynchronous and secure federated machine learning, demonstrated on medical classification tasks. CTGAN appears only inside a saved notebook traceback in the synthetic-data-generation experiment, with no import, dependency or working call surviving in the committed code. The link is an execution artifact rather than a use.
evidence: Jupyter Simulations/2. WB Cancer Classification/Synthetic Data Generation using GAN.ipynb:735 (stack trace only)

title: SecureML
summary: A library of utilities for building privacy-preserving machine-learning systems, covering anonymisation, differential privacy and synthesis. SDV is the synthesis backend, declared as an unpinned dependency and driven through `GaussianCopulaSynthesizer` in the worked examples, with copulas resolved beneath it. Synthetic generation in this toolkit is SDV wearing a privacy-oriented wrapper.

title: TabularFM
summary: An open framework for tabular foundation models, pretraining transferable representations across many tables. The SDV stack is embedded rather than imported: `ctgan` is vendored in-tree with its data transformer still built on RDT's `ClusterBasedNormalizer` and `OneHotEncoder`, while SDMetrics' `QualityReport` scores the output and both are pinned. SDV supplies the encoding and evaluation layers a foundation-model framework is built on top of.

title: Voiceome
summary: A large clinical study collecting voice recordings labelled with health traits, published with the analysis tooling used on it. The SDV link is inherited: a full copy of the Allie framework sits under `data/test/allie`, carrying its CTGAN augmentation module and `ctgan==0.2.1` pin. Nothing in the study's own code calls SDV, so this records a vendored tool rather than a use.

title: Kubeflow blog
summary: The Kubeflow project's blog, with one post on generating synthetic data inside Kubeflow Pipelines. That post is a tour of SDV's synthesizer families, walking through fitting `GaussianCopulaSynthesizer` and `CTGANSynthesizer` and describing `PARSynthesizer` for sequential data inside a pipeline component. It records SDV being taught as the synthesis step of an MLOps platform.

title: Secure and Private AI Products masterclass
summary: Course material for a masterclass on designing secure and private machine-learning systems and products. Its synthetic-data unit is taught on SDV end to end: the demo loader, `GaussianCopulaSynthesizer` and `run_diagnostic` all appear in the same notebook, so students learn generation and validation together.

title: machine_learning_study
summary: A personal set of Chinese-language machine-learning study notes with accompanying code, organised by topic. The data-processing module runs both paths of the SDV family: `sdv.tabular.GaussianCopula` with `sdv.evaluation` for scoring, and `CTGANSynthesizer` imported directly. The pre-1.0 namespace dates the material.

title: AI Programmer magazine
summary: A Chinese-language magazine on AI programming, published as dated article directories. One issue covers SDV across two articles, one using the older top-level `SDV` class and another the current `CTGANSynthesizer` with `SingleTableMetadata`. The entry records SDV reaching a non-English practitioner audience.

title: Inside Learning Machines blog code
summary: Code examples accompanying articles on a machine-learning blog, one notebook per article. The article on unbalanced data uses `GaussianCopulaSynthesizer` with `Metadata` as one of four rebalancing techniques, so SDV is presented as an alternative to resampling rather than as the subject.
evidence: Notebook XXXVIII 4 techniques for unbalanced data.ipynb:38-39

title: PIIT Data Analyst bootcamp
summary: Course material for a data-analyst bootcamp, spanning import, inspection and transformation of tabular data. A dedicated notebook teaches SDV, moving from the demo-dataset loader to `GaussianCopulaSynthesizer`. It records SDV entering an introductory analytics curriculum rather than a research setting.

title: MLOps with Databricks
summary: Code accompanying an O'Reilly title on running MLOps workflows on Databricks, built around a hotel-booking example. SDV produces the data the whole book operates on: the data processor imports `Metadata` and `GaussianCopulaSynthesizer` and `sdv==1.24.0` is pinned, so every later pipeline stage consumes SDV output.

title: NHS Skunkworks synthetic data
summary: An NHS AI Lab exploratory pipeline for generating and evaluating synthetic health data, demonstrated with SynthVAE. SDV is present at all three stages: RDT's `HyperTransformer` prepares the data, a vendored `ctgan` directory supplies `sdv.tabular.CTGAN` for MIMIC generation, and `sdv.evaluation` scores the result, with `ctgan` and `copulas` pinned. A public-health body running the SDV stack end to end.

title: SynMeter
summary: A library for tuning, training and evaluating tabular data synthesis on fidelity, privacy and utility, published at CCS 2025. Its GAN synthesizer reuses RDT's `ClusterBasedNormalizer` and `OneHotEncoder` for the mixed-type transform, with `rdt==1.9.1` pinned. SDV's contribution here is the encoding layer rather than a generator.

title: ctgan (R interface)
summary: An R package exposing CTGAN to R users, wrapping the Python implementation through reticulate. The package exists solely to call `ctgan$CTGANSynthesizer`; every model it fits is SDV's. It records CTGAN crossing into a second language ecosystem, which is the widest form of adoption in this batch.

title: Awesome Grok Skills
summary: A collection of skills and agents packaged for a commercial assistant, one directory per capability. Its synthetic-data skill documents a layered generative architecture with CTGAN and TVAE as the concrete models an agent should reach for. Another instance of SDV packaged as an invocable agent capability.

title: Hernan Huwyler risk management
summary: A collection of R and Python material on risk prediction and quantification, largely Monte Carlo simulation of loss scenarios. A full scan found no SDV import, dependency or reference. Retained at importance 0 so the pooled false positive is recorded rather than re-examined.
evidence: full-tree scan: zero hits for any of the 15 SDV patterns

title: DPSynth
summary: A Google library for differentially private synthetic tabular data generation, taking a set of target queries and producing data that answers them under a privacy budget. SDMetrics is its evaluation dependency, imported in the worked example and declared in the project metadata. SDV supplies the yardstick against which a competing private generator reports quality.

title: FedTabDiff
summary: Implementation of a federated diffusion model for synthetic mixed-type tabular data, distributing training across clients. SDV appears on both sides of the experiment: each federated client builds a `SingleTableMetadata` description, and evaluation uses SDMetrics' `KSComplement` and `TVComplement`, with `ctgan` and `copulas` pinned as baselines. The metadata layer and the column-level metrics are SDV's.

title: CA-CTGAN
summary: A command-line implementation of CA-CTGAN, a context-aware conditional tabular GAN for high-fidelity synthesis. The name states the lineage and the code confirms it: the data handler is built on RDT's `ClusterBasedNormalizer` and `OneHotEncoder`, the same mixed-type transform CTGAN uses, with the context-awareness added on top. A derivative of CTGAN's conditional architecture rather than a user of the library.

title: VibeShip Spawner
summary: An orchestration tool that specialises a coding agent against a project's stack, shipping the skill library it loads. It carries the same SDV skill as the companion skills repository, at `spawner-v2/skills/ai/synthetic-data/collaboration.yaml`, with the identical synthesizer imports and `evaluate_quality` call. This is the upstream that explains the near-identical patterns seen across several skill libraries in this index.

title: Synth Studio
summary: A product for generating privacy-safe synthetic data and compliance packs, aimed at regulated startups in healthcare and fintech. `CTGANSynthesizer` is the generator behind the service, imported in the backend's generator layer. SDV is the engine a commercial compliance offering is built on.

title: My AI Learning Notes
summary: A Chinese-language study path covering twenty-two AI topics, from mathematics through agents and robotics. The synthetic-data chapter positions SDV historically, naming its MIT origin and DataCebo commercialisation and listing CTGAN, PARSynthesizer and the hierarchical multi-table path as its coverage. Description rather than use.

title: ClavaDDPM
summary: Official implementation of ClavaDDPM, a cluster-guided diffusion model for multi-relational data synthesis, published at NeurIPS 2024. SDV supplies both the schema layer and a baseline: `MultiTableMetadata` describes the relational structure the model works over, `CTGANSynthesizer` is one of the compared generators, and `ctgan` and `copulas` are pinned. A multi-table method measured against SDV on SDV's own metadata representation.

title: Constrained DGMs
summary: Code for the ICLR 2024 paper proposing a constraint layer that forces deep generative models for tabular data to respect background knowledge. SDV is threaded through the whole evaluation: `sdv.metrics.tabular` supplies the detection metrics, SDMetrics supplies the classifier-based ones, RDT backs the TableGAN transform, and CTGAN is vendored twice as a constrained baseline. The paper's realism claim is measured largely in SDV's units.

title: CTGAN on credit card data
summary: A study testing whether CTGAN can generate usable tabular data and improve an imbalanced credit-card dataset. A full copy of the CTGAN repository sits in-tree as `CTGAN-master/`, and the notebook imports `CTGANSynthesizer` from it. The work is entirely an evaluation of CTGAN on one dataset.
evidence: CTGAN-master/; CTGAN - Generate Synthetic credit data.ipynb:2541

title: PyCaret Streamlit application
summary: An end-to-end machine-learning web application for classification and regression built on the PyCaret AutoML framework. `sdv` is a declared dependency exercised in a test notebook through the pre-1.0 `sdv.tabular.GaussianCopula`. It is an explored option rather than part of the deployed application path.

title: Learning Ethical AI
summary: A teaching repository on implementing ethical AI, with a healthcare section on synthetic patient data. The generator it teaches is SmartNoise's `DPCTGANSynthesizer`, a differentially private descendant of CTGAN rather than SDV itself. The entry records an indirect lineage: SDV's architecture reaching a curriculum through a third-party derivative.

title: ARNN
summary: An attentive recurrent network for identifying epileptic seizures from multi-channel EEG signals. No SDV import or dependency exists. The pooled match came from `abs_e2687gwsdv`, a conda build-path fragment in a requirements file, the same substring accident already seen elsewhere in this index.

title: Time Series Analysis with Spark
summary: Companion code for a Packt title on time-series analysis with Spark, one directory per chapter. Chapter eight generates its working series with `GaussianCopulaSynthesizer` and `SingleTableMetadata`, so SDV supplies the data the chapter's analysis operates on.

title: BeyondFID
summary: A package for evaluating unconditional image generation models beyond the FID score, published at CVPR 2025. No SDV code is present. The pooled match came from `sdvae`, the stable-diffusion VAE feature extractor named in the dependency comments, which contains the letters sdv by coincidence.

title: Synthetic data evaluation framework
summary: A framework for evaluating synthetic data generation models across fidelity and privacy criteria. It is built directly on SDV's evaluation surface: `SingleTableMetadata` describes the data and SDMetrics' `NewRowSynthesis` measures how far generated rows depart from the training set. SDV supplies the metric definitions the framework organises.

title: unmasking-trees
summary: A method for tabular imputation and generation using gradient-boosted trees over hierarchically binned features, published in TMLR. The SDV baselines are present but disabled: the imports of `GaussianCopulaSynthesizer`, `TVAESynthesizer` and `CTGANSynthesizer` are commented out in the generation script. The comparison was set up and then switched off, so the entry records an intended rather than an executed baseline.

title: Customs Fraud Detection (BACUDA)
summary: Material from the World Customs Organization's BACUDA project, applying machine learning to customs fraud detection across member administrations. A dedicated notebook generates synthetic import declarations with `CTGANSynthesizer`, letting administrations share methods without sharing trade data. An intergovernmental use of CTGAN as a data-sharing mechanism.

title: MLflavors
summary: A package adding MLflow custom flavors for machine-learning frameworks MLflow does not support natively, so their models can be logged, registered and served. SDV is one of the frameworks it adds: the flavor's tests round-trip an `HMASynthesizer`, the example trains against a demo dataset and scores with `evaluate_quality`, and `sdv` is a declared dependency. The entry records SDV being wired into standard MLOps model management.

title: AI and Data Science handbook
summary: A notebook-based Turkish-language handbook of practical AI and data-science examples. One script is a compact SDV lesson, moving from the demo loader through `GaussianCopulaSynthesizer` to `evaluate_quality`. Another instance of SDV reaching a non-English learning audience.

title: DP-MERF
summary: An implementation of differentially private mean-embedding random features for private data generation. SDGym is the data source rather than a competitor: the tabular experiment loads its benchmark datasets through `sdgym.load_dataset`. SDV's benchmark harness supplies the common ground the private method is measured on.
